def make(value):
 def read(): return value
 return read

cell=f.__closure__[0]
print(f() is value,cell.cell_contents is value,id(f())==id(value))
other=value+1
cell.cell_contents=other
print(f() is other,id(f())==id(other),id(value)!=id(other))

def generate(value):
 yield value
 yield value
value=int("1234567890123456789012345")
g=generate(value)
frame=g.gi_frame
print(frame.f_locals["value"] is value,next(g) is value)
other=value+1
frame.f_locals["value"]=other
print(next(g) is other,id(frame.f_locals["value"])==id(other))
g.close()
print(frame.f_locals["value"] is other)
